description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to asynchronous batch stream observation in Orleans. It includes the SequentialItem<T> class for stream items with tokens, and the IAsyncBatchObserver<T> interface for consumers of batched items, including methods to process batches, handle completion, and handle errors.

classes.name: SequentialItem<T>
classes.description: Represents a stream item within a sequence, containing the item and its associated stream sequence token.

methods.name: SequentialItem<T>.SequentialItem
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a SequentialItem with an item and its sequence token.
